prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production modular transparent sprite kit for ANIMOL square-grid puzzle game.
Reference image: the attached existing pond parts is STYLE REFERENCE only. Keep its thick near-black navy outlines, angular cel shading, bright lime/green grass lips, ochre soil and vivid teal water.
Primary request: create a HORIZONTAL two-cell connected shallow pond/pit sluice kit, with a very LOW little wooden water shutter that explains how water can drain between two basins. This is earth excavated below a flat grass floor, NOT a dam, NOT a raised platform.
Layout: exact 3 columns by 2 rows, six well-separated sprite PARTS, transparent background, no labels or text. Every cell same rectangle; sprite centered within its cell. Top-left part 0: a single long horizontal grass/soil bank FRAME surrounding two equal square basin openings joined at the middle by an OPEN EARTH CHANNEL. Both basin interiors and the channel floor are completely transparent holes. Think long figure-eight cutout with a wide waist. No dividing grass wall obstructing the channel. Equal square basin centers 1 cell apart, equal front/back widths, ground horizontal and vertical axes on the screen, front-centered overhead view. Ratio of this frame about 2:1. Part 1 top-middle: only the corresponding dry ochre earth bottom insert, one continuous long shape with two square lobes connected by a narrow channel; no grass, no water, ratio2:1. Part2 top-right: isolated small low WOODEN SHUTTER CLOSED across an east-west channel. Two very short stub posts, a short vertical-on-screen wood slat between them; no tall wall, no tower. Bottom-left part3: the same shutter OPEN, same posts in same positions, wooden slat parked beside the passage leaving obvious gap. Bottom-middle part4: ONLY a thin long teal WATER RIBBON flowing east, several cream pointed ripples clearly pointing RIGHT, no bed, no banks, no arrows or symbols, fully transparent surrounding it. Bottom-right part5: ONLY a tiny receiving splash of teal water with cream glints, no basin, no ground.
Uniform perspective and light from upper left. Keep all six silhouettes separated by transparent gutters. No players, no decorative props, no text, no landscape, no drop shadow beyond edges. The two empty basin holes must really be alpha-transparent, not black paint or checkers. Native transparent RGBA.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: VERTICAL native sprite kit matching ANIMOL's existing pond sprite, thick dark navy outlines, faceted green grass banks, warm ochre soil, clean angular cartoon teal water. Reference images are palette/line style and same low sluice family.
Primary request: make a vertical north-south two-basin ground excavation with a connecting narrow open water channel. The two square ground openings are stacked ONE ABOVE THE OTHER, equal squares with same apparent size, connected at the middle. No isometric tilt, no perspective convergence. The FRONT edge at bottom has a little visible soil thickness, upper edge no huge front face. No isolated raised dirt pedestal and no dam.
Layout exact THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX separate modular sprites, transparent background, no labels. Make cells portrait-proportioned and all six parts visibly separated.
Top left part0: VERTICAL GRASS/LOW SOIL RIM FRAME only: upper square basin hole and lower equal square basin hole linked through the central north-south channel. The basin interiors are genuinely transparent holes; channel cut all the way through the shared bank. Outside contour approximately 1:2 width:height. A/B cell center separation equals a square basin cell width. The single fixed rim is used for every water phase.
Top middle part1: VERTICAL DRY SOIL INSERT only: upper square dry ochre floor and lower square dry ochre floor connected by narrow vertical soil channel. No grass, no water, about1:2 ratio.
Top right part2: a very short low wooden gate CLOSED ACROSS A VERTICAL WATER CHANNEL: left/right stub posts and a horizontal wooden shutter joining them, chunky little rustic sluice. Width about1.8 times height, front overhead view.
Bottom left part3: EXACTLY the same left/right posts in same positions but shutter OPEN, plank parked to the right leaving central channel fully clear. No tall structures.
Bottom middle part4: ONLY a long narrow VERTICAL teal water ribbon flowing DOWN screen, with 3 cream water glints visibly tapered downward, no banks, no ground, no arrow symbols, ratio1:5.
Bottom right part5: tiny isolated teal receiving splash, no floor, no extra objects.
Lighting top left. Keep outlines bold and details readable at game tile size. Everything transparent around art and inside empty basin holes. No text, characters, landscape, grey boxes, shadows or extra parts. Do NOT just rotate a horizontal basin image: keep top/front soil faces and light consistent in this vertical arrangement.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: two matched ANIMOL small wooden sluice gate sprites, native transparent game art.
Style references: attached kits' thick dark navy outlines, low rustic ochre wood, two-tone cel shading and overhead front-centered perspective.
Create exactly TWO sprites side by side on transparent background. This gate is ACROSS a channel where water runs LEFT to RIGHT, so it must extend VERTICALLY ON THE SCREEN, not horizontally. The first sprite CLOSED: one short stub post at TOP, one stub post at BOTTOM, with a thin flat wooden sliding shutter extending UP-DOWN joining those posts across the east-west water passage. Top/bottom posts share the SAME X coordinate. Overall narrow portrait silhouette, about width 1 to height 2.1. NO posts to left/right, no horizontal fence, no arch, no tall wall. Very low to ground with tiny front faces consistent with overhead game sprites.
Second sprite OPEN: the SAME fixed top/bottom stub posts at identical screen coordinates, wooden shutter shifted upward and parked beside upper post to leave the CENTRAL channel passage empty. The gap is alpha transparent. Still low little sluice hardware, not a dam or full doorway.
Equal size and registration; exactly two isolated parts, no ground, no water, no shadows outside art, no glowing background, no labels, no text, no arrows. True RGBA transparency.

postprocessing: Native alpha crops, uniform registration, fixed banks/posts, compositing and translation of native water/glints only; no procedurally painted sprite art.
